summary: Payoneer payout failed: supplier account temporarily restricted — USD 18,000 held in escrow
root_cause: Payoneer flagged supplier account for compliance review due to a sudden spike in transaction volume. Account is temporarily restricted until review completes. Payment cannot be processed automatically.

remediation_steps.description: Contact Payoneer support to understand account restriction reason and ETA
remediation_steps.result: HITL escalation raised for operator to contact Payoneer

remediation_steps.description: Request supplier to provide identity documents to unblock Payoneer account
If Payoneer resolution takes >48h, initiate wire transfer as fallback
Confirm payment receipt with supplier before releasing escrow hold
